_comment: Photography direction for generated imagery. Build-time only — the app never imports this. Prompts are derived from here plus catalog.json by scripts/build_image_prompts.py.
grade: editorial fashion photography, restrained saturation, warm-neutral white balance, true blacks that are not crushed, premium but natural
gradeSubject: realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural fabric weave
exclusions: no HDR look, no heavy grain, no extreme depth of field, no runway posing, no visible fashion-brand logos or branding of any kind, no text, no watermark, no added graphics, no distorted hands

packshot.shared: The garment fills 70 to 78 percent of the frame, centred with even margins. Plain seamless linen background, colour #E9E5DE. Soft broad studio light from above and slightly in front, with one subtle natural contact shadow beneath the garment. Straight-on camera perspective with no tilt, identical across the catalogue.

byCategory.outer: front-facing invisible ghost-mannequin presentation, garment holding a natural three-dimensional shoulder line, lapels sitting correctly and symmetrically, sleeves hanging naturally at the sides, front hanging as the garment is cut
byCategory.top: front-facing invisible ghost-mannequin presentation, garment holding natural three-dimensional structure, collar and placket keeping their shape, sleeves falling naturally
byCategory.dress: front-facing invisible ghost-mannequin presentation, full length, natural drape through the skirt, shoulder line and neckline holding their shape
byCategory.bottom: front-facing invisible ghost-mannequin presentation, full length from waistband to hem, natural drape through the leg, waistband and overall silhouette clearly readable
byCategory.shoes: a single shoe photographed at a three-quarter side angle with the toe pointing slightly towards frame left, sitting flat on the surface with a natural contact shadow
byCategory.bag: presented upright and turned roughly twelve degrees from front, handles standing naturally, body holding its own structure

avatar.composition: head-and-shoulders portrait, square crop, head occupying roughly 55 percent of the frame height, eyes on the upper third
avatar.pose: facing the camera, relaxed natural expression, slight turn of the head
avatar.lighting: soft directional window light from camera left, gentle fill on the shadow side
avatar.background: plain warm neutral backdrop, softly out of focus

amira.name: Amira Saleh
amira.reference: Egyptian woman, early thirties. Warm medium-olive skin. Oval face with a defined jawline and straight dark brows. Dark brown, almost black hair, centre-parted and gathered low at the nape. A small mole below the left cheekbone. Minimal makeup, no earrings.

lina.name: Lina Mansour
lina.reference: Lebanese woman, late twenties. Fair olive skin with cool undertones. Heart-shaped face with a softly rounded chin. Dark brown hair cut blunt at the collarbone, tucked behind the right ear. Faint freckles across the nose and cheeks. No jewellery.

omar.name: Omar Khaled
omar.reference: Egyptian man, mid twenties. Medium brown skin. Square face with a broad forehead. Short dark curly hair kept tight at the sides. Close-cropped full beard. A small scar through the outer end of the right eyebrow.

nour.name: Nour Hassan
nour.reference: Egyptian woman, early thirties. Warm brown skin. Round-oval face with full cheeks. Wears a softly draped hijab that covers the hair completely; the fabric is a plain warm neutral that changes between Looks. Fine gold-rimmed glasses. Calm, direct expression.

karim.name: Karim Adel
karim.reference: Egyptian man, mid thirties. Medium olive skin. Long face with a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Short dark hair neatly side-parted, with a little grey at the temples. Clean shaven.

sara.name: Sara El-Masry
sara.reference: Egyptian woman, late twenties. Warm brown skin. Soft square face. Long dark brown hair, naturally wavy, worn loose past the shoulders. Small gold stud earrings. Easy open expression.

amira-soft-tailoring.pose: Standing in a slight three-quarter turn towards camera left, weight settled on the back foot, chin level, head and eyes to camera.
amira-soft-tailoring.composition: Full length, head to toe. The subject occupies 65 to 72 percent of the frame height and stands a little left of centre. Feet slightly apart with both loafers completely visible against the ground. The upper ten percent of the frame is calm and uncluttered, reserved for navigation controls.
amira-soft-tailoring.camera: 50mm, eye level, subject parallel to the sensor
amira-soft-tailoring.setting: a quiet Cairo side street in early morning light, shopfronts far enough behind to fall softly out of focus
constraints: the trouser waistband is visible where the shirt meets it, so trousers read as a separate block from the blazer
the tote is carried in the left hand and held away from the torso, with daylight visible between the bag and the hip
no two garments overlap or obscure one another
the background immediately behind the body is simple, with nothing that competes with the garments

lina-grey-minimal.pose: Leaning back against the wall, shoulders touching it, one knee bent with the sole of the shoe flat against the wall. Hands loose at the sides, head turned slightly away from camera.
lina-grey-minimal.composition: Full length, subject offset to the right third and filling about 80 percent of the frame height. Both sneakers visible.
lina-grey-minimal.setting: a pale concrete wall in flat overcast daylight

omar-underpass.pose: Mid-stride walking towards the camera, left leg forward, arms swinging naturally, hood down, looking past the camera to the right.
omar-underpass.composition: Full length with the motion held. Subject centred, filling about 78 percent of the frame height, both trainers visible with the forward foot flat to the ground.
omar-underpass.camera: 50mm, eye level, moderate depth of field so the trainers stay sharp
omar-underpass.setting: a concrete stairwell landing in hard autumn side light

nour-colonnade.pose: Walking through the colonnade in a three-quarter view to camera, the coat open and moving with the stride, one hand steadying the bag strap at the shoulder.
nour-colonnade.composition: Full length. Subject on the left third, walking into the open right side of the frame. Columns receding behind. Both boots visible.
nour-colonnade.setting: a stone colonnade in low autumn sun, long shadows across the floor

karim-lobby.pose: Standing asymmetrically with the weight on one hip, both hands in the trouser pockets, jacket open, looking off camera.
karim-lobby.composition: Full length, subject centred, filling about 75 percent of the frame height.
karim-lobby.setting: a terrazzo and brass hotel lobby at night under warm low light

lina-oatmeal-knit.pose: Standing at a slight angle, one hand in a trouser pocket, the other holding a coffee cup at her side, looking down the street.
lina-oatmeal-knit.composition: Full length, subject on the right third, filling about 78 percent of the frame height.
lina-oatmeal-knit.setting: a quiet winter street in soft grey daylight

sara-denim-uniform.pose: Walking across the frame from left to right, the tote carried naturally in the outside hand, head turned back towards camera.
sara-denim-uniform.composition: Full length in motion, subject centred and filling about 76 percent of the frame height, both sneakers visible.
sara-denim-uniform.setting: a leafy pavement on a bright spring morning

amira-black-tailoring.pose: Standing square to camera with one foot turned slightly out, the bag held low in one hand, the other arm relaxed.
amira-black-tailoring.composition: Full length, subject centred, filling about 70 percent of the frame height. Both loafers visible.
amira-black-tailoring.setting: a dark marble entrance hall in the evening, one warm light source off frame

amira-rooftop-edit.pose: Editorial three-quarter pose, body angled away from camera with the head turned back, one hand lifting the open jacket at the hip.
amira-rooftop-edit.composition: Full length, subject on the left third, filling about 74 percent of the frame height.
amira-rooftop-edit.setting: a Cairo rooftop at golden hour with a hazy skyline behind

amira-summer-linen.pose: Relaxed walking pose towards the camera, the straw tote swinging in one hand, looking slightly off camera.
amira-summer-linen.composition: Full length in motion, subject centred, filling about 76 percent of the frame height, both sandals visible.
amira-summer-linen.setting: a whitewashed wall in bright summer sun with palm shadow falling across it
